approval: Michael approved these country-scene concepts and requested the landmark/taller-hat revisions; exact new assets not yet owner-reviewed.

input_policy.lock_scope: All face input (tap, double-tap menu gesture on face, drag/dodge/chase, petting, pestering counter), idle scheduler and motion/sensor reactions are locked for the full scene duration.
input_policy.ignored_input: Discarded, NOT queued. No delayed chirp/menu/squish after scene end.
input_policy.held_pointer_at_end: If any pointer is still down at scene end, normal gestures stay gated until that pointer is released/cancelled; only a NEW pointerdown starts a gesture.
input_policy.start_gate: Never start a scene (idle or otherwise) while a drag/pet contact is active or another scene is running; one scene at a time.
always_available: mute (silences scene music immediately via gain ramp ~30-60 ms; visual continues)
visibilitychange hidden/pagehide: stop and dispose audio, cancel scene timers safely
browser/OS navigation and exit — never trapped; no fullscreen/kiosk capture
input_policy.finish: Return to exact plain Buddy neutral (identity transform, default eyes/mouth, no overlay/prop, no audio source), then unlock.
